text: 啲人話渠後生嗰陣好勤力做嘢。

english.text: For too many of us the political equality we once had won was meaningless in the face of economic inequality. A small group had concentrated into their own hands an almost complete control over other people's property, other people's money, other people's labor — other people's lives. For too many of us life was no longer free; liberty no longer real; men could no longer follow the pursuit of happiness.

jyutping: deoi3 jyu1 ngo5 dei6 dong1 zung1 taai3 do1 jan4 lai4 gong2，ngo5 dei6 cang4 ging1 jeng4 dak1 ge3 zing3 zi6 ping4 dang2，min6 deoi3 ging1 zai3 bat1 ping4 dang2，hai6 mou5 ji3 ji6 ge3。jat1 go3 siu2 kwan4 tai2 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 gei1 fu4 jyun4 cyun4 hung3 zai3 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 coi4 caan2、kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 cin4、kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 lou4 dung6 lik6 — kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 sang1 ming6 ge3 hung3 zai3 kyun4 zaap6 zung1 hai2 zi6 gei2 sau2 soeng6。deoi3 ngo5 dei6 dong1 zung1 taai3 do1 jan4 lai4 gong2，sang1 wut6 ji5 ging1 m4 zoi3 hai6 zi6 jau4；zi6 jau4 ji5 ging1 m4 zoi3 hai6 zan1 sat6 ge3；
text: 對於我哋當中太多人嚟講，我哋曾經贏得嘅政治平等，面對經濟不平等，係冇意義嘅。一個小群體已經將幾乎完全控制其他人嘅財產、其他人嘅錢、其他人嘅勞動力 — 其他人嘅生命嘅控制權集中喺自己手上。對我哋當中太多人嚟講，生活已經唔再係自由；自由已經唔再係真實嘅；
